content.storyline: Chicago enters Week 11 at 7-2, tied with Detroit and Minnesota atop the NFC North, making this a division-position game for the Bears; New Orleans is 3-6 after a 20-17 Week 10 loss to Carolina.
matchup_notes: Chicago's 7-2 record placed it in a tie with Detroit and Minnesota for the NFC North lead entering Week 11; the Bears were coming off their Week 10 bye.
New Orleans fell to 3-6 with a 20-17 Week 10 loss to Carolina.
The NFL matchup page listed Chicago seventh in both points per game (26.8) and yards per game (383.2); New Orleans ranked 15th in points (22.4) and 22nd in yards (314.2).
